title.en: The first panic Monday of COVID-19

briefing.id: Senin, 9 Maret 2020. COVID-19 menyebar ke banyak negara. Akhir pekan lalu pertemuan OPEC+ gagal mencapai kesepakatan (6 Maret) dan Arab Saudi memangkas harga jual minyaknya, memicu kekhawatiran perang harga. Pasar dibuka pagi ini dengan lompatan harga besar di banyak aset. Saldo $3.000.
briefing.en: Monday 9 March 2020. COVID-19 is spreading to many countries. Late last week the OPEC+ meeting ended without a deal (6 March) and Saudi Arabia cut its oil selling prices, raising fears of a price war. Markets opened this morning with big price jumps across many assets. Balance $3,000.

title.id: Setelah SNB melepas batas kurs franc
title.en: After the SNB drops the franc cap

briefing.id: Kamis malam, 15 Januari 2015. Pagi tadi Swiss National Bank secara mengejutkan menghapus batas kurs EUR/CHF 1,20 yang dijaganya sejak 2011, dan pasar mata uang bergejolak hebat. Euro juga tertekan oleh dugaan bahwa ECB akan segera melonggarkan kebijakannya. Saldo $2.000.
briefing.en: Thursday evening, 15 January 2015. This morning the Swiss National Bank shocked the market by scrapping the EUR/CHF 1.20 floor it had defended since 2011, and currency markets swung wildly. The euro is also under pressure from expectations that the ECB will ease policy soon. Balance $2,000.

title.en: A snap election called out of the blue

briefing.id: Rabu, 19 April 2017. Kemarin Perdana Menteri Theresa May secara mengejutkan mengumumkan pemilu dini pada 8 Juni. Pasar menafsirkannya sebagai peluang May memperkuat mayoritasnya sebelum negosiasi Brexit, dan poundsterling melonjak. Saldo $1.200.
briefing.en: Wednesday 19 April 2017. Yesterday Prime Minister Theresa May surprised everyone by calling an early election for 8 June. The market read it as a chance for May to strengthen her majority before the Brexit talks, and sterling jumped. Balance $1,200.

title.en: Sterling ahead of the November 2017 BoE meeting

briefing.id: Pertengahan Oktober 2017. Sejak September Bank of England memberi sinyal bahwa suku bunga mungkin naik dalam beberapa bulan ke depan, dan pasar memperkirakan kenaikan pada rapat 2 November. Negosiasi Brexit masih berjalan alot. Saldo $8.000.
briefing.en: Mid-October 2017. Since September the Bank of England has signalled rates may rise in the coming months, and the market expects a hike at the 2 November meeting. The Brexit talks are still difficult. Balance $8,000.

title.id: Dolar-yen saat imbal hasil AS naik

briefing.en: Early March 2021. US 10-year bond yields climbed sharply through February on vaccine optimism and a planned $1.9 trillion US fiscal package, while the Bank of Japan keeps Japanese yields near zero. Balance $5,000.

briefing.en: Early October 2018. The Italian government's budget plan with a bigger deficit has sparked tension with the EU and weighed on the euro. US 10-year yields are at their highest since 2011 and stock markets are starting to wobble. Balance $2,200.

title.en: Wanting to win it back past the limit

briefing.id: Awal Januari 2017. Harga bijih besi dan batu bara yang tinggi sejak akhir 2016 menopang AUD, dan AUD/USD naik di awal tahun. Namun hari ini kamu sudah rugi dua kali dengan total −3% saldo, melewati batas rugi harian 2% di rencanamu, dan kamu merasa ingin segera mengembalikannya. Saldo sekarang $4.850.
briefing.en: Early January 2017. High iron ore and coal prices since late 2016 are supporting AUD, and AUD/USD has risen at the start of the year. But today you've already lost twice for −3% of the balance in total, past the 2% daily loss limit in your plan, and you feel like winning it back right away. Your balance is now $4,850.

title.id: Akun kecil di dolar-yen yang tenang
title.en: A small account on a quiet dollar-yen

briefing.id: Agustus 2014. The Fed terus mengurangi pembelian obligasinya dan diperkirakan menghentikannya pada Oktober, sementara Bank of Japan tetap menjalankan pelonggaran besar. USD/JPY bergerak sangat tenang. Rabu (20 Agustus) pukul 18.00 UTC risalah rapat FOMC dirilis. Akunmu kecil: saldo $250, dan lot terkecil 0,01.
